name: Lost & Found

transitions.provenance: derived — GST-001 declares entryState.params subjectId, so an edge into it must carry them
derived — GST-003 declares entryState.params eventId, so an edge into it must carry them

notes: States derived from the screen pattern on 17 August, not individually considered. Purpose derived from the screen name and its operations on 17 August, not from a requirement. **Navigation repointed to P15 on 20 August** — the F&B screens it linked to moved out of the back office when the client board was adopted. **Cross-platform navigation removed 24 August**: BO-021. **A till does not navigate to a back office and a guest app does not navigate to either** — those are device handovers, and a flow declares them with `crossesDevice` rather than a screen pretending there is a link. **Rebuilt 24 August.** This screen declared exactly one operation — `getGuestOrderStatus` — **order tracking on a lost-property screen.** A guest reporting a lost bag could not raise anything. **Lost and found is a case**, the same object as a complaint and a query, which is what lets one queue serve all three. **Guest case operations wired 24 August.** **No case operation was guest-callable** — a guest could raise nothing and read nothing, and `check-screens` refused the staff-permissioned ones on a guest surface. `listMyCases`, `raiseMyCase` and `replyToMyCase` are scoped to the caller rather than filtered by a subject parameter.
openQuestions: Inventory cites `POST /lost-found/reports` — no matching operation. Written before the contracts existed.
patternReason: `listMyCases` reads a population and nothing reads one of them; the detail is the row until a `get` exists
purpose: See lost & found for this venue.

states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed and leaves the lost found untouched.
states.emptyFirstRun: No lost found yet. Carries the create action; distinct from a filter that matched nothing.
states.emptyNoResults: The filter narrowed it and the lost found are still there. Names the active filter and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: Names the missing permission. **Never an empty table** — that reads as *there is no data* and sends somebody to support with the wrong question.
states.offline: **The offline banner shows.** Reports already loaded stay read-only with their age. Reporting and replying need the connection.

apis.purpose: Report something — lost property, a complaint, a question
Reply on a case the guest raised

entryState.coldEntry: **A guest opening an order link weeks later.** Shows the order if it still resolves; if it was refunded or the performance passed, says which and offers the order list rather than an error. A case opened from a notification or the list. **Optional** — the ordinary way in is to raise a new one, not to open an old one.

apisNote: Rebuilt 9 September 2026 from the 3 operations this screen declares, not from a workshop pack — it has none. Columns are every field the response schema declares, plumbing aside — narrowing them to the ones that matter is work a person still owes this screen.

offlineBanner.message: You're offline. Connect to the internet to book, pay, order or join a queue.
offlineBanner.shows: The moment the connection drops, on every screen, above the screen's own content.
offlineBanner.clears: By itself as soon as the connection is back, with a short "Back online" confirmation.
offlineBanner.never: Covers what is already on screen, or appears for a server error — that is the screen's own error state, and a guest told they are offline when the venue is down reconnects for nothing.
offlineBanner.provenance: Decided 12 September 2026 — guest web and guest app behave identically offline and say so with the same banner.

targetApp.name: TICVAI Guest
targetApp.note: **One guest product in three shells.** Web, mobile and kiosk share 73–91% of their operations; the kiosk is the same product in a fixed frame with no keyboard, and is deliberately narrower rather than different.
